strings.name: Bill Gates
strings.role: Microsoft co-founder · Global health and philanthropy
strings.summary: Bill Gates co-founded Microsoft with Paul Allen and helped build the personal-computer software industry. His leadership encompassed rapid growth and antitrust litigation. After leaving daily management, he focused on foundation programs in health, education and poverty reduction, alongside clean-energy innovation.
strings.coverageNote: Sources checked through 13 November 2026; selected milestones extend to 2026, not an exhaustive news record. Institutional achievements are team efforts; announced plans are not completed results.
strings.influence.rationale: Co-founded Microsoft and advanced personal-computing software; later supported global health and education through philanthropy.
strings.facts.fact-1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.fact-2.label: Education
strings.facts.fact-2.value: Attended Harvard University, 1973–1975; no completed degree
strings.highlights.highlight-1.title: Personal-computing software
strings.highlights.highlight-1.text: Led Microsoft’s operating-system and application businesses, expanding access to PC software.
strings.highlights.highlight-2.title: Global health philanthropy
strings.highlights.highlight-2.text: Funded health and development programs; announced accelerated spending and a planned 2045 closure in 2025.
strings.timeline.event-1.title: Higher foundation payout
strings.timeline.event-1.text: The board approved an annual payout level of US$9 billion, completing an earlier growth plan.
strings.timeline.event-2.title: Foundation sunset plan
strings.timeline.event-2.text: Announced roughly US$200 billion in spending over twenty years and a planned closure at the end of 2045.
strings.timeline.event-3.title: Left Microsoft’s board
strings.timeline.event-3.text: Stepped down to devote more time to health, education and climate work.
strings.timeline.event-4.title: Left day-to-day Microsoft work
strings.timeline.event-4.text: Shifted his principal working focus from company operations to the foundation.
strings.timeline.event-5.title: Established the Gates Foundation
strings.timeline.event-5.text: Co-founded the foundation with Melinda, consolidating earlier philanthropic initiatives.
strings.timeline.event-6.title: Microsoft antitrust lawsuit
strings.timeline.event-6.text: The U.S. Justice Department and states sued Microsoft while Gates was CEO.
strings.timeline.event-7.title: First Windows release
strings.timeline.event-7.text: Microsoft launched Windows, extending graphical-interface software for personal computers.
strings.timeline.event-8.title: Co-founded Microsoft
strings.timeline.event-8.text: Developed software for the Altair computer with Paul Allen and established the company.
strings.timeline.event-9.title: Entered Harvard
strings.timeline.event-9.text: Began university studies, leaving in 1975 to work on Microsoft.
strings.timeline.event-10.title: Born in Seattle
strings.timeline.event-10.text: Born in Washington state; encountered computer programming as a teenager.
